crossRefs.note: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

translations.web: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.
translations.bsb: He is a well-watered plant in the sunshine, spreading its shoots over the garden.
translations.kjv: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
translations.asv: He is green before the sun, And his shoots go forth over his garden.
